report_name: Sahaay AI Phase 4 - Hyderabad Risk AI Data Quality Audit

flooding_locations.notes: 23 chronic waterlogging hotspots in GHMC core arterial network.

hyderabad_drains.notes: 96 primary storm water drains/nalas with multi-vertex linestrings.

greater_hyderabad_waterbodies.notes: 2,324 tanks/lakes across Greater Hyderabad & Rangareddy catchment basins.

hyderabad_monthly_rainfall_1901_2021.notes: 121-year climatological baseline. Serves as seasonal reference percentiles, NOT real-time forecasts.

telangana_hourly_telemetry_rainfall.spatial_resolution_limitation: Telemetry stations are regional reservoir/dam gauges situated 47km to 113km from Hyderabad center. Data represents regional catchment rainfall, NOT hyper-local road-level precipitation.
telangana_hourly_telemetry_rainfall.non_silent_missingness_rule: MANDATORY: Missing telemetry intervals must NEVER be silently imputed as 0 mm. Missingness triggers confidence discounting and explicit reason codes.
telangana_hourly_telemetry_rainfall.source_provenance: National Water Data Portal (NWIC) / Telangana Surface Water Dept

critical_findings: Flooding locations dataset contains 23 static historical waterlogging points with zero time-series outcome labels.
Telemetry rainfall exhibits 50.8% cumulative gauge accumulator entries (>250mm) and 19 negative sensor errors which must be filtered.
Telemetry weather stations are located 47km to 113km from Hyderabad center, requiring regional-scale attribution and confidence discounting.
Supervised predictive ML is NOT scientifically justified due to absence of dynamic ground-truth flood outcome labels.
